<thought>We need to retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 sulfide compositions, then consolidate, prepare a tabular dataset, train an XGBoost model, evaluate it, perform cross‑validation, and finally save the required metrics to a JSON file. The first step is to fetch the polymorphs for a representative set of sulfide formulas using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool, storing the results in a sub‑directory of the current workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "FeS", "FeS2", "CuS", "Cu2S", "ZnS", "PbS", "MoS2", "WS2",

    "Ag2S", "CdS", "Ga2S3", "In2S3", "Al2S3", "SiS2", "TiS2", "V2S5",
    "Cr2S3", "MnS", "MnS2", "GeS", "GeS2", "HfS2", "ZrS2", "Y2S3",
    "La2S3", "Ce2S3", "Pr2S3", "Nd2S3", "Sm2S3", "Eu2S3", "Gd2S3",
    "Tb2S3"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_sulphides_trial_0/sulfide_data"
